title.zh: Microsoft Staff Asked If AI Scraping Was 'Largest Theft of Labor in Human History'
title.en: Microsoft Staff Asked If AI Scraping Was 'Largest Theft of Labor in Human History'

current_state.zh: Unsealed filings in the New York Times' copyright suit against OpenAI and Microsoft show Microsoft employees internally debated whether AI scraping of news articles amounted to 'the largest theft of labor in human history' and could trigger a model-degrading 'doom loop,' while Satya Nadella testified that paywalled content should be licensed.
